meta.rule: preregistration 6: 12 months if the dry-run estimate is at most half of the sandbox monthly free query volume, else 6 months (pypistats)
meta.query:
SELECT
  project,
  COUNTIF(timestamp <= @mid) AS downloads_first_half,
  COUNTIF(timestamp > @mid) AS downloads_second_half
FROM `bigquery-public-data.pypi.file_downloads`
WHERE timestamp > @start
  AND timestamp <= @cutoff
  AND project IN UNNEST(@packages)
GROUP BY project
ORDER BY project
